class.name: NNSTAllOfGuard
class.brief_description: Returns [code]true[/code] if all of the [member guards] are satisfied.
class.description: This guard returns [code]true[/code] only if all of the [member guards] are satisfied, and [code]false[/code] otherwise. Use it to require multiple conditions to hold at the same time. An empty [member guards] array returns [code]true[/code]. Any [code]null[/code] entries in [member guards] are skipped, so an array containing only [code]null[/code] entries also returns [code]true[/code]. It reports the bitwise OR of the trigger types of all non-null entries in [member guards] from [method NNSTGuard.get_supported_trigger_types].

members.member: Guards that must all be satisfied for this guard to return [code]true[/code] (evaluated in order, short-circuiting on the first failure). [code]null[/code] entries are skipped, and an empty array evaluates to [code]true[/code].
